article: YYFKGCP B0GCBNTBT8 four-contact magnetic connector in pump-cap and front-top seats

contact_coupon_print.scope: Printer-reported completion of two contact-seat coupons. Physical roof quality, connector fit, insert fit, lead passage and continuity are not established by printer completion.

reported_physical_connector_fit.statement: Regarding the compression, I have already test fit in test piece that was printed and things are good, please ensure that is documented.
reported_physical_connector_fit.scope: Successful fit and mating/compression in the printed test piece. The report gives no numerical gap or pin-travel measurement and does not identify the complete enclosure as the tested article.

accepted_pump_holder_fit.scope: Both pumps held firmly with holder screws tightened and no vertical play. This observation does not include the pogo connector or magnet retention.
